mission: Adapt the operational plan to the collapsed timeline and hold the group together as philosophical differences become survival-level disagreements.
why_now: Veraine's sabotage during the truce has collapsed the timeline from weeks to days. Philosophical differences become operational emergencies. Torin's decision is imminent.
conflict: Ben vs. time. Philosophical differences become operational under pressure.
turning_point: Torin in the doorway: 'We need to talk about what happens when we get there.' His voice calm, warm, decided. Ben's stomach drops.
emotional_trajectory: Under time constraint, true priorities surface
notes: Emergency protocol. Maximum speed to Veranthos. Torin's hook: 'We need to talk about what happens when we get there.' His voice calm. Decided.
